entries.f42864c09842b5eb: Responding to client requests, it provides a combination of marketing consulting and design production and sales promotion operation support. The annual securities report explains that it is an integrated sales promotion service covering the entire path to sale, in both real and online channels. In recent years, it has also focused on proposals that link media such as electronic shelf labels and digital signage.
entries.f65dfd57d9d22ebc: All-media promotion support including electronic shelf labels, digital signage and apps
entries.f6e0b8e075e3a6ac: A service that plans sales promotion measures from the analysis of marketing data, tailored to the characteristics of each client's market and area. The securities report states that, beyond simply collecting and analyzing big data, in-house staff well versed in distribution and retail handle everything from interpreting the analysis results to forming hypotheses. Specifically, it lists the collection and analysis of various marketing data and trend data, the planning and proposal of sales promotion concepts, sales promotion plans and policies for advertised products, and surveys of competing stores and competing markets. The content is running the PDCA cycle of planning, executing, evaluating and improving measures. The amount is not disclosed separately.
entries.f7589671393bcef3: [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual securities report]] states that the Group (the company and one consolidated subsidiary) makes the 'Integrated Sales Promotion Support Business' its main business, providing integrated support for sales promotion, from planning, proposals and design to the production of promotional materials, for retail and distribution businesses, starting with food supermarkets. Using newspaper inserts as its main medium, it offers plans that incorporate marketing, data analysis, research, the internet and smartphones, and consistently provides all-media promotion support, including electronic shelf labels, digital signage and apps. The sales promotion support fees the company receives are calculated by multiplying a unit price that takes overall services into account, such as marketing analysis, planning and proposals, and design production, by the number of copies for which production support is provided for newspaper inserts. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,761,878 thousand.
